projects.title: Dynamic Codespaces
projects.description: A partner and I developed a containerized cloud IDE platform that dynamically provisioned isolated Theia development environemnts. I configured Nginx as a reverse proxy to route users to unique URLs for their active development environments. We implemented automated container lifecycle management with inactivity detection and self-termination to reclain server resources.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio (reccursion)
projects.description: I developed a personal developer portfolio website using React with Vite. It is a single page application that seamlessly navigatese across multiple views, displays local image assets, presents dynamic project data fetched from an external source, and captures visitor messages.

projects.title: Inventory Tracker Capstone
projects.description: A capstone project focused on building an inventory tracking application. The app helps users organize inventory items and keep track of stock levels through a straightforward interface.
